catalogue_requests.reason: the catalogue has no class for writing a pulsed laser's frequency and diode current instructions and applying them; cap.device.configure.v1 binds writable resource state, which this package keeps read-only (the driver exposes its reads as state and never as a writable @write), and cap.optics.set_power.v1 is a power setpoint in mW at R2

the catalogue has no class for clearing a laser activation instruction; the closest classes (cap.optics.shutter.v1, cap.imaging.illumination.v1, cap.optics.set_power.v1) set a power, a shutter state or an intensity, none of which maps the upstream activation instruction

notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level); the gate raised no warning and no finding. Model-authored and unreviewed: reviewed_by stays null and nothing ran on a laser. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card is family-config / SerialDriver, but the PDM protocol is framed binary (length, address, numeric command id, data and an XOR checksum, pypdm/pdm.py:188-233) and the upstream builds every frame from parts at run time, so a SerialDriver command table cannot express it and gate G7 cannot find text tokens for it; this package is a direct Driver over pypdm.pdm:PDM with a native.py factory, and the card should get an override. NOT COVERED: enabling emission, because no action sets the activation instruction to True; the package reads the state, configures frequency and currents, and only clears the activation (safe-state action and e-stop). NOT COVERED: writing the pulse width and the delay, which are read only here. NOT COVERED: the protocol-3.7-only software_control_mode and control_mode_selection properties, which raise ProtocolVersionNotSupported on a 3.4 to 3.6 device; the driver does not guess the version. NOT COVERED: the serial framing, the daisy-chain Link sharing and the wire protocol, because the fake stands in for the PDM object, not for the link; the card's preferred mock strategy 'transcript' has no transcript artifact in the clone (tests/conftest.py monkeypatches serial.Serial and the gate never imports upstream code), so fake.py is an in-memory package fake whose values are placeholders. The clone states the maxima of frequency, pulse width and delay, but only the frequency and current bounds are written here, so no operator_required limit and no site-limits.example.json are needed. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-29; reviewed_by stays null): accepted after reviewer edits: risk raised from R1 to R2 (a laser above class 1; a class 3B or 4 source is R3, MHS/spec/04-safety.md), so the hardware backend waits for a human signature; native.py and facts.md now say so. The DEVIATION FROM THE CARD is accepted: a registry override now makes the card a direct driver. After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.
